title.narrative: Promoting Disability Inclusive Sustainable Development Goals: Making Targets Reality

description.narrative: ADD Bangladesh, are currently undertaking work entitled: SDGs and Disability: Making Targets Reality. ADD is seeking to expand their existing engagement in SDGs (disability focused) work at the national and local level with support from this fund. ADD International were significantly involved in lobbying for the inclusion of disability issues in the SDGs at the international level and are now working to engage in the roll out of SDGs at the national level. The following major activities planned for the proposed work supported by CAFOD are; 8 district and 3 divisional level SDG familiarisation workshops with Disabled People's Organisations (DPOs), government departments and Civil Society Organisations (CSOs), policy influencing work targeting various Ministries and their concerned departments. Advocating for more budget allocation at the national and local government level (80 Union Parisad), linking SDGs, UN Convention of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and National Disability law commitments and how these can be tracked through DPOs by strengthening their capacity (3 DPO training sessions), 2 national dialogues, media engagement, 4 inter-ministerial coordination meetings in terms of resource allocation and financing some specific goals related to disable people and the SDGs. The project is funded under CAFOD's PPA Top-up funding for work on the Sustainable Development Goals.
